Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor tax data & PO readiness — SSN masking request

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. We attached our completed W-9 but have a couple of asks before you create the PO:

- The W-9 includes the sole proprietor's SSN. Lumenexa's vendor policy requires masking of SSNs in third-party portals and in any PO/Paperwork visible to non-finance teams. Can Redwood create the vendor record with a masked identifier (e.g., XXX-XX-1234) for display while retaining the full SSN in the secure tax vault for 1099 processing?
- If Redwood requires EIN instead, we can supply a corporate EIN but need guidance on whether we should submit an amended W-9 since our legal entity is changing signatory structure.

We also attached a recent bank letter for ACH onboarding. Please let us know the minimal set of docs you need today to move the PO into a provisional status so we can start work next week.

Appreciate it,
Olivia Marsh
Vendor Operations lead
Lumenexa, Inc.

---
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Marsh <olivia.marsh@lumenexa.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor tax data & PO readiness — SSN masking request

Hi Olivia,

Thanks — received. Quick answers below and next steps:

1) Masking policy: We can display a masked SSN (XXX-XX-1234) in the vendor portal and PO PDFs for non-finance users. The full SSN must be submitted to Finance/Tax and will live encrypted in our vendor tax store (access controlled).

2) EIN vs SSN: For vendor setup we prefer an EIN when available because it avoids 1099 ambiguity and speeds onboarding. If your legal entity will be the payee (corporation/LLC taxed as corp), please send a corrected W-9 with the EIN. If the payee is an individual or sole proprietor and you must use SSN, we will still onboard but need the signed W-9 and a copy of the bank letter.

3) Provisional PO: Procurement can issue a provisional PO (no payment terms) if we have: signed W-9, bank letter, and authorized signer name & title. Final PO (with payment) requires tax-id verification by Finance.

I'll have Kimberly and Ben confirm the internal checklist and SLA for the verification step.

Best,
Sofia
Vendor Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor tax data & PO readiness — SSN masking request

Looping in the finance checklist here. For full PO activation we need:

- Signed W-9 (matching payee name and TIN) — PDF, signed, not a photo if possible
- Bank letter (recent, <90 days) for ACH confirmation
- Proof of authorized signer (email from legal or government registration)
- If using SSN: copy of SSN confirmation (we accept IRS 147C, CP2100 response, or equivalent)

If Lumenexa provides EIN and an updated W-9 with EIN populated, that will be the fastest path. If they insist on an SSN, we will accept it but will place the record into a restricted-access tax state until we validate. That restriction means the PO can be provisional but payments cannot be scheduled until validation completes (usually 2–5 business days).

We can redact/mask SSNs in PDFs shared via the portal; full SSN is stored encrypted and accessible only to Finance/Tax role. Please confirm whether Lumenexa prefers a provisional PO (work can start) or to wait for full validation.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sr. Financial Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Olivia
